value.rationale: The natural rational branch point of an automorphism-free simple-CM genus-five quotient has an exact non-generic weight-four gap sequence. It reveals the first available single-point pole order 4 and hence a rational totally ramified degree-four map; such local divisor data are not implied by genus or a CM field alone and motivate further study of divisors on the explicit quotient.
